## 12 PRIMAVERA UNIFIER

- 12.1 The Contractor shalluse the Oracle PRIMAVERA UNIFIER "Automated System"" or any other Automation application/software that may be instructed by the Employer, to carry out the Project management processes including online approvals (unless otherwise requested to be in form of signed / stamped Hard copy), submissions and tracking of the submissions across all project phases.
- 12.2 The Employer will purchase and supply adequate number of licenses for Automation application for use by himself and his contractors' staff.
- 12.3 The Contractor must assure that his staff has knowledge and experience on using the Automation application and any other system required for proper administration of the project. In case the Contractor's staff requires any training, then Contractor must arrange for training courses with Project Manager.
